name: zSentinel · Vliegende keep
goal: Finish already-open product PRs on main with the existing CI/review/ownership gates, then restore stalled workers and blocked delivery routes across canonical projects without displacing active claims.
next_step: Start with existing open product PRs: inspect exact-head required CI, independent review and any conflicts; merge only with an authorized live exclusive mainwriter lease, GitHub permission and verified default-branch commit. For HOLD or unknown-owner work, run the read-only scripts/zsentinel_issue_first_board.py --project cloud (plus up to two independent canonical projects) to prioritize open P0/P1 issues already referenced by existing non-QA PRs. For a known P0/P1 issue missed by the recent 100-PR window use --project cloud --issue <existing number> instead of creating a duplicate new PR; verify source identity and source incompleteness before selecting work. Treat PR-body references as hints, never proof of a fix or owner vacancy; inspect active Notion/queue claims before touching a task. Repair real CI/conflicts or safely deliver another freely owned P0/P1 fix; never start new QA suites, bypass security/release gates or deploy without owner authority.

milestones.title: Deliver owned product PRs and restore blocked project execution
